source.title: Miststalker's Wristbands live item and related disenchanting listings

notes: Name-based search across Wowhead live/PTR, Reddit, Blizzard forums and WoW-Professions. Live Wowhead shows base item level 206 and scaled item level 321; PTR 12.1.5 and 12.1.7 show a bonus-configured item level 305. Neither listing supplies a verified actual-item-level-305 completed disenchant cohort or skill/build. Reddit mining and prospecting discussions are qualitative or concern gathering, not prospect output. Guide Eversong Diamond unlock requirement is already represented in seeded conditions; do not duplicate. No completed casts, per-output hit counts, histograms, zero outcomes or yield totals established.
lookingFor: New independent Midnight disenchanting gear-quality/ilvl/skill cohorts for Miststalker's Wristbands 272246; rank-specific Umbral Tin 237362/237363, Eversong Diamond 242608, Refulgent Copper 237359 and Brilliant Silver 237364 prospecting, and milling completed-cast histograms.
